# status/

`rows.json`: the shape, symbol, colour and words of an agent's row in the Mac's sessions list:
`StatusShape(row:isComingBack:)`, `StatusShape.isTinted` and `StatusShape.words(row:isComingBack:)`
(`UI/StatusShape.swift`), which `StatusIcon` in `App/Sources/AgentList/AgentRow.swift` draws.
